stages.title: Validate the customer problem
stages.summary: Confirm the proposal bottleneck before choosing software.

tasks.title: Choose a region and contractor segment
tasks.description: Name the geography and contractor type you will investigate first.

tasks.title: Interview five operators
tasks.description: Use the discovery script and record evidence without inventing demand.

tasks.title: Record the current quotation and follow-up process
tasks.description: Map the hand-offs, delays, owners, and tools used today.

stages.title: Explore and adapt the demonstration
stages.summary: Map required fields and calculations to an approved scope.

tasks.title: List materials and labour inputs
tasks.description: Capture only the inputs needed for an initial quotation workflow.

tasks.title: Define quotation states
tasks.description: Agree the states, owners, and next actions used in the pipeline.

tasks.title: Remove features the customer does not need
tasks.description: Keep the pilot bounded by documenting excluded features explicitly.

stages.title: Define the offer and project scope
stages.summary: Bound the setup, migration, training, and support commitments.

tasks.title: Write a scope sheet
tasks.description: List the configuration, migration, training, and handover work included.

tasks.title: Define ownership and support limits
tasks.description: Record responsibilities, revision limits, hosting, and ongoing support boundaries.

stages.title: Research suitable potential customers
stages.summary: Build a small, relevant outreach list.

tasks.title: Identify 20 local contractors
tasks.description: Create a focused list using public business information.

tasks.title: Prioritise teams with bespoke quotations
tasks.description: Rank prospects whose work appears to require complex proposal follow-up.

stages.title: Demonstrate the solution and agree a pilot
stages.summary: Use fictional or authorised sample data in a focused walkthrough.

tasks.title: Prepare a 15-minute demo
tasks.description: Show the agreed workflow using fictional or authorised sample records.

tasks.title: Agree success and exit criteria
tasks.description: Document what the pilot will test and how either party can stop it.

stages.title: Test, launch, and support
stages.summary: Verify access, backups, and communication before handover.

tasks.title: Run permission tests
tasks.description: Verify each role can access only the records and actions it needs.

tasks.title: Document recovery and ownership
tasks.description: Record backup, recovery, credential, and support responsibilities.

stages.title: Map the current quotation workflow
stages.summary: Record systems, owners, states, and exceptions.

tasks.title: Identify the source of truth
tasks.description: Name the authorised system that owns quotation status.

tasks.title: Document how replies are recorded
tasks.description: Map how customer replies stop or change follow-up work.

stages.title: Choose reminder intervals
stages.summary: Agree cadence, business-day rules, and exclusions.

tasks.title: Define offsets
tasks.description: Agree when internal follow-up should become due.

tasks.title: List holidays and excluded states
tasks.description: Prevent reminders on unsuitable days or completed records.

stages.title: Configure logic and destinations
stages.summary: Use the customer’s authorised tools and scoped access.

tasks.title: Map fields
tasks.description: Map stable quotation IDs, dates, owners, and statuses between systems.

tasks.title: Configure task and notification destinations
tasks.description: Send internal work only to the agreed responsible people.

stages.title: Test normal and failure scenarios
stages.summary: Prove duplicate prevention and visible failures in a sandbox.

tasks.title: Run the same check twice
tasks.description: Confirm a retry does not create a duplicate internal task.

tasks.title: Test missing data
tasks.description: Confirm incomplete records fail visibly and safely.

tasks.title: Test an expired connection
tasks.description: Confirm an expired authorisation creates an actionable failure.

stages.title: Run a one-person pilot
stages.summary: Limit the first live trial to one responsible team member.

tasks.title: Agree a five-day trial
tasks.description: Keep the first live window short and owned by one person.

tasks.title: Review the audit log daily
tasks.description: Check executions, skips, duplicates, and failures every day.

stages.title: Document ownership and maintenance
stages.summary: Make credentials, alerts, and support boundaries explicit.

tasks.title: Write the handover matrix
tasks.description: Record who owns credentials, alerts, data, and support.

tasks.title: Schedule a maintenance review
tasks.description: Choose when schemas, permissions, and connections will be reviewed.

stages.title: Choose one service and area
stages.summary: Keep the initial research narrow enough to validate.

tasks.title: Define the service category
tasks.description: Choose one specific service with a clear buyer need.

tasks.title: Choose a postcode cluster
tasks.description: Bound the initial demand and provider research geographically.

stages.title: Interview recent buyers
stages.summary: Understand how people search, compare, and decide.

tasks.title: Ask about urgency
tasks.description: Record when and why a buyer needed a provider quickly.

tasks.title: Record trust and qualification questions
tasks.description: Capture the evidence buyers use to compare providers.

stages.title: Discover provider partners
stages.summary: Confirm capacity, coverage, and response expectations.

tasks.title: Interview five providers
tasks.description: Confirm coverage, availability, fit, and response expectations.

tasks.title: Agree a manual pilot handoff
tasks.description: Define who receives, qualifies, and follows up each enquiry.

stages.title: Prototype the enquiry journey
stages.summary: Use fictional submissions and clear consent language.

tasks.title: Draft the landing page
tasks.description: Explain the service, area, handoff, and limitations clearly.

tasks.title: Prototype qualification fields
tasks.description: Collect only the information needed for the agreed handoff.

stages.title: Run a bounded pilot
stages.summary: Track response quality without promising lead volume.

tasks.title: Route enquiries manually
tasks.description: Use the documented consent and partner handoff process.

tasks.title: Review response times and fit
tasks.description: Record whether enquiries were suitable and handled promptly.
